units.source_text: 在岛村看来，驹子这种生活可以说是徒劳无益的，也可以说是对未来憧憬的悲叹。

en.t: To Shimamura, Komako's way of life could be called futile and pointless, and it could also be seen as a sorrowful longing for the future.

units.source_text: 不过这种生活也许对她本身是有价值的，所以她才能弹出铿锵有力的琴声。

en.t: Yet perhaps that life had value for her herself, and that was why she could draw such ringing, powerful music from the instrument.

units.source_text: 岛村靠耳朵分辨不出她那纤纤素手的灵巧工夫，所以仅从弦音里理解她的感情。

en.t: Shimamura could not tell by ear the deft work of her slender white hands, so he understood her feelings only through the sound of the strings.

units.source_text: 但对驹子来说，他恐怕是最好的听众了。

en.t: But for Komako, he was probably the best listener she could have had.
